analogy.rationale: Calmodulin antagonists block calcium-calmodulin signaling, overlapping with calcium channel blockers and calcineurin inhibitors that act on the same calcium-dependent pathway; however, calmodulin is ubiquitously expressed and its inhibition produces only modest, non-specific transcriptional changes in these cell lines.
